title: The Doctor Who Removed Healthy Organs for 'Science'

title: The Hospital That Strapped Patients to Beds for 20 Years

why_this_can_go_viral: The horror of being trapped in your own body and ignored by medical staff triggers deep emotional engagement and outrage.
